howto.name: Upload up to 100 PDFs
howto.text: Drag up to 100 PDF files. The tool reads only metadata, not content — page counts come back almost instantly.

howto.name: Read the per-file count
howto.text: Each filename appears with its page count. The total across all files appears at the bottom — ideal for print quotes.

faq.q: How is this faster than opening each PDF?
faq.a: The tool reads only the PDF's page metadata, not the page content. For 100 PDFs the total scan time is typically under a second.

faq.q: Does it work on encrypted PDFs?
faq.a: Yes for most. Password-protected PDFs that block metadata access return as invalid.
Yes — print shops use this exact tool to count total pages across multi-file print jobs for instant quotes.
